snippet.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The world of Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance needs YOUR help...

Fire spreading faster than anyone can run. A ceiling that could come down at any second. Some places are too hot, too tight, too unstable to send a person into - so you send a drone instead.

Wishlist RDS: Second Chance now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4498520/Rescue_Drone_Simulator_Second_Chance/

Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

A brand new publisher Anraga Studios is teaming up with Farm51 (Chernobylite, Get Even) to bring this new drone narrative experience to players!

Follow our journey on Social Media!
